QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts 3] The Strange Video
QuestInfo.0: A call came from #bSpencer#k, the scientist you aided in winning freedom for the #bWondroids#k. What could he want to talk about?
QuestInfo.2: #bSpencer#k says trouble is brewing at the old Aspire facility. Head to the Wondroids Hideout and find out what's going on.
